Description.Name: 廖氏
Description.Details: 你出生并成长于[[DM.Factions[faction_Liao]  卡佩兰联邦]]。

OptionDescription:
出身于[[DM.Factions[faction_Liao]  卡佩兰联邦]]的机师是坚毅而忠诚的战斗者，能守住阵线，常常让那些错误低估他们的对手大吃一惊。

在过去两个世纪的战争中，卡佩兰联邦在其他[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreSuccessorState]  继承国]]手中吃的苦头最多，失去了它曾在[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreStarLeague]  星盟]]统治鼎盛期控制过的近一半领土。随着时间推移，[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHouseLiao]  廖家族]]的领导层把卡佩兰联邦改造成一个经济高度管制的社会主义警察国家。大多数卡佩兰人为自己的公民身份深感自豪，而这必须通过对国家的服务来赢得。
BioDescription: You were born and raised in the Capellan Confederation. MechWarriors who hail from the Capellan Confederation are dedicated and steadfast combatants, capable of holding the line and often surprising those opponents who would make the mistake of underestimating them. Most Capellans take great pride in their citizenship, which must be earned through service to the state.
